title: One make-gate run failed once and never reproduced; package unidentified
description:
The first of five whole-repo `make gate` runs on this worktree exited 1; the failing package's line was lost to a tail pipe, and the failure never reproduced in four later full gates plus a -count=5 pass over every touched package. The learnings already record host-dependent flakes on this shared machine (live runs, other agents), so this is most likely one of those, but it could also be a latent flake nobody has named. Worth a look only if it repeats for another worker on this host.
evidence: make gate exit 1 at 2026-10-04 ~19:20 local on branch ticfac/run-epic-hn6/tick-ghh/attempt-8; four later full gates and go test -short -count=5 on ./internal/exec/subprocess/ ./internal/statusmodel/ ./internal/contracts/... ./internal/cli/ all green; no failing test name captured
